While she was performing CPR, I immediately notified the nearby hospital. After a few tense moments, she came back on the line and shouted, “Where’s the ambulance?” I replied, “It’s getting there as quickly as it can.”
questions.stem:
다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말을 조건에 맞게 영어로 쓰시오.

__________ and my heart was racing.
(내 목소리는 떨리고 있었다.)

[조건] (1) my, trembling, voice, was를 모두 사용할 것
       (2) 정확히 4단어로 쓸 것

det.korean: 내 목소리는 떨리고 있었다 → My voice was trembling (4단어)
det.analysis: 주어(My voice) + 과거진행(was trembling).
